subject: HelioHealth case study publication & quote usage
messages:
From: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@heliohealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Nov 2025 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: HelioHealth — interest in being featured in a case study

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team found Redwood's latency and cost visibility extremely compelling. We'd be interested in doing a short case study and a customer spotlight page to highlight the production results. A few items we need from your side to move forward: 

- Draft of the case study for internal review
- Permission form for use of our logo and a 1-2 sentence quote from our CEO
- Confirmation on whether the case study might appear in paid marketing (we need to clear that)

If you can send a draft and any legal language up front, I can circulate internally. Target for publication is late November but flexible.

Best,
Alicia Torres
Director, Partnerships
HelioHealth

Attachments: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Nov 2025 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HelioHealth — interest in being featured in a case study

Hi Alicia,

Awesome — excited to do this. Please find attached a first-pass draft of the case study and a short permission form that covers logo usage, quotes, and timebox of use. High level notes: we plan a web feature, a 1-page PDF, and possibly social posts. If you prefer to limit channels, let us know and we’ll adjust.

Quick ask: would it be possible for Rita to provide a one-line quote we can use? If helpful, I’ve penciled in a suggested quote in the draft (see page 2).

Next steps from our side: incorporate any legal redlines and publish after your sign-off. 

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Product Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0127

Attachments: helio_draft_case_v1.pdf, permission_form_draft.docx

From: Kiran Das <kiran.das@heliohealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@heliohealth.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Nov 2025 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HelioHealth — interest in being featured in a case study (permission form redlines)

Marissa / Alicia,

Thanks for sharing. I reviewed the permission_form_draft.docx and attached a redlined version with three primary edits:

1) Timebox the usage: limit web and collateral use to 24 months from execution (we're willing to re-consent after that).
2) Remove rights for use in paid advertising without separate approval — we can approve social organic and owned channels but not paid media by default.
3) Add a mutual indemnity paragraph referencing accuracy of quoted metrics and data provenance.

I attached HH_redlines_v1.pdf with inline comments. Once you incorporate, please send back for final review.

Regards,
Kiran Das
General Counsel
HelioHealth
kiran.das@heliohealth.com

Attachments: HH_redlines_v1.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kiran Das <kiran.das@heliohealth.com>, Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Nov 2025 09:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HelioHealth — interest in being featured in a case study (permission form redlines)

Hi Kiran, Alicia —

Thanks for the quick review and the redlines. We can accommodate the items you flagged. Proposed responses:

- Usage term: happy to set the default term to 24 months with an option to renew thereafter.
- Paid media: we will remove language that grants blanket permission for paid advertising. We will request separate sign-off if we decide to promote via paid channels.
- Mutual indemnity: our legal team (cc'd: Stephanie) will draft a short mutual accuracy clause; see suggested sentence below.

Suggested mutual accuracy sentence for your review:
"Each party represents that any factual statements provided about the other party are accurate to the best of its knowledge; neither party will be liable for inadvertent typographical errors and any disputed factual claims will be corrected promptly upon notice."

Also, Alicia — Rita’s suggested quote that we included in the draft was: "Redwood gave us consistent low-latency inference and a single-pane of cost visibility that reduced our TCO by over 30% within months." If Rita prefers an alternate wording, we can update.

If Kiran is OK with the redlines and Stephanie signs off on the mutual clause, we can prepare a final permission form for signature. We can also mask any raw metrics if you’d rather keep numbers out of public copy.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: none

From: Rita Alvarez <rita.alvarez@heliohealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Kiran Das <kiran.das@heliohealth.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Nov 2025 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HelioHealth — interest in being featured in a case study (permission form redlines)

Marissa / Alicia / Kiran,

Thanks — the suggested quote looks good to me as-is. I authorize HelioHealth’s marketing team to proceed with the case study publication on the condition that the redlined permission form is updated per Kiran’s notes and we receive the final form for signature. We do not authorize use in paid advertising without a separate approval step.

Approve to publish once: (1) Redwood incorporates the 24-month term and paid-media restriction; and (2) HelioHealth legal signs the final permission form.

Rita Alvarez
CEO, HelioHealth
rita.alvarez@heliohealth.com
